question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> is a sparingly soluble salt of molar mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mfenced><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi>mol</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math> and solubility <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> The solubility product satisfies <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi>sp</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><msup><mfenced><mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi></mfrac></mfenced><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>.</mo></math> The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></math> is __________ . (Integer answer)

solution.text:
Solubility =xm mole/lit
A3B2s⇌3A2+3xM(aqs)+2B3-(aqs)2xM
Ksp=3xM32xM2
=3322xm5
=27×4xm5
=108xm5=axM5
So a=108
